deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 1 for the following fall; late neuroscience applications may be considered.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines are December 1 to begin the following fall for the PhD Programs.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not reviewed and need not be submitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not reviewed and do not need to be submitted.

also.quote: Please note that we will NOT consider GRE scores in our application review process.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not considered in the review, including any subject test.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that we will NOT consider GRE scores in our application review process.

supervisor.value: Admission is by the committee; applicants name a preferred major professor, which the department tries to honor.
supervisor.quote: The admissions committee examines GPA, courses taken, research record, and letters of recommendation

also.quote: In the graduate school application, you will indicate your preferred major professor.

funding.value: The fetched page does not state funding terms for the neuroscience doctorate.

entry_route.value: The page mentions master's holders getting coursework waivers, but does not say whether bachelor's applicants enter directly.

fee_waiver.value: Only attendees of the departmental virtual information session get a fee waiver, and only by following its procedures.
fee_waiver.quote: Attendees of the departmental virtual information session will be eligible to receive an application fee waiver.

notes: Neuroscience is one of the Psychology PhD's doctoral programs (clinical, neuroscience). The department says about 12 new doctoral students are admitted each year from 350+ applications.
